requirements_xml:
<requirements_list>
  <requirement id="R1">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioContext interface must be exposed on the Window global scope.</description>
    <spec_quote>[Exposed=Window]
interface OfflineAudioContext : BaseAudioContext</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R2">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioContext interface must inherit from BaseAudioContext.</description>
    <spec_quote>interface OfflineAudioContext : BaseAudioContext</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R3">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioContext must expose a constructor accepting an OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary argument.</description>
    <spec_quote>constructor(OfflineAudioContextOptions contextOptions);</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R4">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioContext must expose a constructor accepting numberOfChannels, length, and sampleRate arguments.</description>
    <spec_quote>constructor(unsigned long numberOfChannels, unsigned long length, float sampleRate);</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R5">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioContext must expose a startRendering() method accepting an optional nullable chunkSize argument and returning a Promise resolving to an AudioBuffer.</description>
    <spec_quote>Promise<AudioBuffer> startRendering(optional unsigned long? chunkSize = null);</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R6">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioContext must expose a resume() method returning a Promise resolving to undefined.</description>
    <spec_quote>Promise<undefined> resume();</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R7">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioContext must expose a suspend() method accepting a suspendTime argument and returning a Promise resolving to undefined.</description>
    <spec_quote>Promise<undefined> suspend(double suspendTime);</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R8">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioContext must expose a close() method returning a Promise resolving to undefined.</description>
    <spec_quote>Promise<undefined> close();</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R9">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioContext must expose a readonly nullable length attribute of type unsigned long.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute unsigned long? length;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R10">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioContext must expose an oncomplete EventHandler attribute.</description>
    <spec_quote>attribute EventHandler oncomplete;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R11">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary must define a numberOfChannels member of type unsigned long.</description>
    <spec_quote>unsigned long numberOfChannels = 1;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R12">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary must define a nullable length member of type unsigned long.</description>
    <spec_quote>unsigned long? length = null;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R13">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary must define a required sampleRate member of type float.</description>
    <spec_quote>required float sampleRate;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R14">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary must define a renderSizeHint member accepting an AudioContextRenderSizeCategory or unsigned long value.</description>
    <spec_quote>(AudioContextRenderSizeCategory or unsigned long) renderSizeHint = "default";</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R15">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioCompletionEvent interface must be exposed on the Window global scope.</description>
    <spec_quote>[Exposed=Window]
interface OfflineAudioCompletionEvent : Event</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R16">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioCompletionEvent interface must inherit from Event.</description>
    <spec_quote>interface OfflineAudioCompletionEvent : Event</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R17">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioCompletionEvent must expose a constructor accepting a type DOMString and an OfflineAudioCompletionEventInit dictionary.</description>
    <spec_quote>constructor (DOMString type, OfflineAudioCompletionEventInit eventInitDict);</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R18">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>OfflineAudioCompletionEvent must expose a readonly renderedBuffer attribute of type AudioBuffer.</description>
    <spec_quote>readonly attribute AudioBuffer renderedBuffer;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R19">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioCompletionEventInit dictionary must inherit from EventInit.</description>
    <spec_quote>dictionary OfflineAudioCompletionEventInit : EventInit</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R20">
    <category>Existence</category>
    <description>The OfflineAudioCompletionEventInit dictionary must define a required renderedBuffer member of type AudioBuffer.</description>
    <spec_quote>required AudioBuffer renderedBuffer;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R21">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Constructing an OfflineAudioContext with an OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary must initialize both its control thread state (exposed via the state attribute) and rendering thread state to "suspended".</description>
    <spec_quote>1. Set the `[[control thread state]]` for c
       to `"suspended"`.
    2. Set the `[[rendering thread state]]` for
       c to `"suspended"`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R22">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Constructing an OfflineAudioContext with an OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary must set its sampleRate attribute to the value of contextOptions.sampleRate.</description>
    <spec_quote>3. Set the `sampleRate` for c,
       based on the value of `contextOptions.sampleRate`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R23">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Constructing an OfflineAudioContext must succeed for any sample rate between 3000 Hz and 768000 Hz, inclusive.</description>
    <spec_quote>Implementations MUST support sample rates between 3000 Hz and 768000 Hz,
inclusive.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R24">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When constructing an OfflineAudioContext with contextOptions.renderSizeHint omitted, set to "default", or set to "hardware", its render quantum size (exposed via renderQuantumSize) must be set to 128.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. If it has the default value of `"default"` or
          `"hardware`", set the `[[render quantum size]]` private
          slot to 128.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R25">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When constructing an OfflineAudioContext with an integer contextOptions.renderSizeHint within the supported range, its render quantum size (exposed via renderQuantumSize) must be set to that integer value.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. Else, if an integer has been passed, a `NotSupportedError` MUST be
          thrown if the value is outside the range specified in
          [§ 2.5 Supported Render Quantum Sizes](#render-quantum-sizes), otherwise set the `[[render quantum size]]`
          private slot to the passed value.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R26">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Constructing an OfflineAudioContext with an integer renderSizeHint must succeed for any value between 1 sample frame and floor(6 * sampleRate), inclusive.</description>
    <spec_quote>Implementations MUST support `[[render quantum size]]` between 1 sample frame and 6 times the context sample rate,
inclusive, rounding down to the nearest integer if 6 times the context
sample rate is not an integer.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R27">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When constructing an OfflineAudioContext with an OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary in which numberOfChannels is omitted, numberOfChannels must default to 1.</description>
    <spec_quote>unsigned long numberOfChannels = 1;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R28">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When constructing an OfflineAudioContext with an OfflineAudioContextOptions dictionary in which length is omitted, length must default to null.</description>
    <spec_quote>unsigned long? length = null;</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R29">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Constructing an OfflineAudioContext must create its AudioDestinationNode (destination) with channelCount set to contextOptions.numberOfChannels.</description>
    <spec_quote>5. Construct an `AudioDestinationNode` with its
       `channelCount` set to
       `contextOptions.numberOfChannels`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R30">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>An OfflineAudioContext's AudioDestinationNode must have default values of 1 for numberOfInputs, 1 for numberOfOutputs, "explicit" for channelCountMode, and "speakers" for channelInterpretation.</description>
    <spec_quote>For an `OfflineAudioContext`, the defaults are

| Property | Value | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `numberOfInputs` | 1 |  |
| `numberOfOutputs` | 1 |  |
| `channelCount` | numberOfChannels |  |
| `channelCountMode` | "`explicit`" |  |
| `channelInterpretation` | "`speakers`" |  |
| [tail-time](#tail-time) | No |  |</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R31">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Constructing an OfflineAudioContext must create a MessageChannel, assign its port1 to audioWorklet.port, and queue a control message to transfer and set port2 on the AudioWorkletGlobalScope.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. Let messageChannel be a new `MessageChannel`.
    7. Let controlSidePort be the value of
       messageChannel’s `port1` attribute.
    8. Let renderingSidePort be the value of
       messageChannel’s `port2` attribute.
    9. Let serializedRenderingSidePort be the result of
       StructuredSerializeWithTransfer(renderingSidePort,
       « renderingSidePort »).
    10. Set this `audioWorklet`’s `port` to
        controlSidePort.
    11. [Queue a control message](#queuing) to [set the
        MessagePort on the AudioContextGlobalScope](#setting-the-messageport-on-the-scope), with
        serializedRenderingSidePort.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R32">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Constructing an OfflineAudioContext with the three-argument constructor (numberOfChannels, length, sampleRate) must initialize the context identically to calling the dictionary constructor with { numberOfChannels, length, sampleRate }.</description>
    <spec_quote>The OfflineAudioContext is constructed as if

    ```
    new OfflineAudioContext({
            numberOfChannels: numberOfChannels,
            length: length,
            sampleRate: sampleRate
    })
    ```

    were called instead.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R33">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>The length attribute of an OfflineAudioContext must return the total size of the audio render in sample-frames equal to the length parameter passed to the constructor.</description>
    <spec_quote>The total size of the audio render in sample-frames. This is the same
    as the value of the `length` parameter for the constructor.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R34">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When startRendering(chunkSize) is called on an OfflineAudioContext with a non-null length, if chunkSize is not null and the sum of previously committed frames and chunkSize is less than length, the buffer length to render must be set to chunkSize (before render quantum alignment).</description>
    <spec_quote>2. Otherwise, if the `OfflineAudioContext`’s
          `length` is not `null`:
          1. If
             `chunkSize`
             is not `null` and `[[committed frames]]` +
             `chunkSize`
             is less than the `OfflineAudioContext`’s
             `length`, set bufferLength to
             `chunkSize`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R35">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When startRendering(chunkSize) is called on an OfflineAudioContext with a non-null length, if chunkSize is null (omitted) or the sum of previously committed frames and chunkSize is greater than or equal to length, the buffer length to render must be set to length minus previously committed frames (before render quantum alignment).</description>
    <spec_quote>2. Otherwise, if the `OfflineAudioContext`’s
          `length` is not `null`:
          1. If
             `chunkSize`
             is not `null` and `[[committed frames]]` +
             `chunkSize`
             is less than the `OfflineAudioContext`’s
             `length`, set bufferLength to
             `chunkSize`.
          2. Otherwise, set bufferLength to
             `length` - `[[committed frames]]`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R36">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When startRendering() is called on an OfflineAudioContext with length equal to null and chunkSize omitted or null, the buffer length to render must be set to the context's render quantum size.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. If the `OfflineAudioContext`’s
          `length` is `null`:
          1. If
             `chunkSize`
             is `null`, set bufferLength to
             [render quantum size](#render-quantum-size).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R37">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When startRendering(chunkSize) is called on an OfflineAudioContext with length equal to null and a non-null chunkSize, the buffer length to render must be initialized to chunkSize (before render quantum alignment).</description>
    <spec_quote>5. Let bufferLength be a number initialized to the
       value of the
       `chunkSize`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R38">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>In startRendering(), if the computed bufferLength is not a multiple of the context's render quantum size, it must be rounded up to the next multiple of the render quantum size.</description>
    <spec_quote>6. If bufferLength is not a multiple of
       [render quantum size](#render-quantum-size), round it up to the next multiple of
       the [render quantum size](#render-quantum-size).</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R39">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>startRendering() must create an AudioBuffer whose numberOfChannels and sampleRate match the OfflineAudioContext's constructor options and whose length equals the computed bufferLength.</description>
    <spec_quote>7. Create a new `AudioBuffer` buffer, with a number of
       channels and sample rate equal respectively to the
       `numberOfChannels` and
       `sampleRate` values passed to this instance’s
       constructor in the `contextOptions` parameter;
       and length equal to bufferLength.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R40">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Beginning offline rendering for a buffer must render buffer.length sample-frames of audio into that buffer using the context's current node connections and scheduled changes.</description>
    <spec_quote>1. Given the current connections and scheduled changes, start
       rendering buffer’s `length`
       sample-frames of audio into buffer.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R41">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Once offline rendering of a buffer completes, a media element task must resolve the promise returned by startRendering() with that rendered AudioBuffer.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. Once the rendering is complete,
       queue a media element task to execute the following steps:
       1. Resolve the promise created by `startRendering()`
          with buffer.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R42">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>For an OfflineAudioContext with a non-null length, once a buffer finishes rendering and total rendered frames are greater than or equal to length, a control message must be queued to close the OfflineAudioContext.</description>
    <spec_quote>4. Set `[[rendered frames]]` to the sum of
          `[[rendered frames]]` and the `length`
          of buffer.
       5. If `length` is not `null`:
          1. If `[[rendered frames]]` is greater than or
             equal to `length`,
             [Queue a control message](#queuing) to close the
             `OfflineAudioContext`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R43">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>For an OfflineAudioContext with a non-null length, once a buffer finishes rendering, a complete event using the OfflineAudioCompletionEvent interface with renderedBuffer set to the rendered AudioBuffer must be fired at the OfflineAudioContext.</description>
    <spec_quote>5. If `length` is not `null`:
          1. If `[[rendered frames]]` is greater than or
             equal to `length`,
             [Queue a control message](#queuing) to close the
             `OfflineAudioContext`.
          2. Queue a media element task to
             fire an event named
             `complete` at the
             `OfflineAudioContext` using
             `OfflineAudioCompletionEvent` whose
             `renderedBuffer` property is set to
             buffer.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R44">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When an OfflineAudioContext finishes rendering and fires both statechange and complete events, the statechange event must be fired before the complete event.</description>
    <spec_quote>This
    event is fired before the `complete` event
    is fired.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R45">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling suspend(suspendTime) with a valid suspendTime must schedule a suspension of rendering at the specified time quantized and rounded up to the nearest render quantum boundary.</description>
    <spec_quote>Schedules a suspension of the rendering at the specified time, which is quantized and rounded up to the [render quantum](#render-quantum) size.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R46">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When a suspended OfflineAudioContext is resumed after rendering has started, it must continue rendering the audio graph into the buffer.</description>
    <spec_quote>3. If a suspended context is resumed, continue to render the
       buffer.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R47">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When resume() succeeds on an OfflineAudioContext, it must resolve the returned promise and, if the state attribute is not already "running", set state to "running".</description>
    <spec_quote>4. queue a media element task to execute the following steps:

       1. Resolve promise.
       2. If the `state` attribute of the
          `OfflineAudioContext` is not already "`running`":

          1. Set the `state` attribute of the
             `OfflineAudioContext` to "`running`".</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R48">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When resume() transitions an OfflineAudioContext's state attribute to "running", it must fire a statechange event at the OfflineAudioContext.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. If the `state` attribute of the
          `OfflineAudioContext` is not already "`running`":

          1. Set the `state` attribute of the
             `OfflineAudioContext` to "`running`".
          2. Queue a media element task to fire an event named
             `statechange` at the `OfflineAudioContext`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R49">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Calling close() on a non-closed OfflineAudioContext must suspend progression of currentTime and stop processing audio data.</description>
    <spec_quote>Closes the `OfflineAudioContext`. This will not automatically release
    all `AudioContext`-created objects, but will suspend the progression
    of the `AudioContext`’s `currentTime`, and stop
    processing audio data.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R50">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When close() runs on a non-closed OfflineAudioContext, it must resolve the returned promise and, if the state attribute is not already "closed", set state to "closed".</description>
    <spec_quote>3. queue a media element task to execute the following steps:

       1. Resolve *promise*.
       2. If the `state` attribute of the
          `OfflineAudioContext` is not already
          "`closed`":

          1. Set the `state` attribute of the
             `OfflineAudioContext` to
             "`closed`".</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R51">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>When close() transitions an OfflineAudioContext's state attribute to "closed", it must fire a statechange event at the OfflineAudioContext.</description>
    <spec_quote>2. If the `state` attribute of the
          `OfflineAudioContext` is not already
          "`closed`":

          1. Set the `state` attribute of the
             `OfflineAudioContext` to
             "`closed`".
          1. queue a media element task to
             fire an event named
             `statechange` at the
             `OfflineAudioContext`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R52">
    <category>Common Use Cases</category>
    <description>Constructing an OfflineAudioCompletionEvent with an OfflineAudioCompletionEventInit dictionary must set its renderedBuffer attribute to the provided renderedBuffer.</description>
    <spec_quote>`renderedBuffer`, of type [AudioBuffer](#AudioBuffer)
:   Value to be assigned to the `renderedBuffer` attribute of the event.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R53">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Constructing an `OfflineAudioContext` when the current settings object's relevant global object's associated Document is not fully active must throw an `InvalidStateError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>If the current settings object’s relevant global object’s
    associated Document is NOT fully active,
    throw an `InvalidStateError` and abort these steps.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R54">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Constructing an `OfflineAudioContext` with an integer `renderSizeHint` in `contextOptions` that is outside the supported render quantum size range (less than 1 or greater than `Math.floor(6 * sampleRate)`) must throw a `NotSupportedError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>Else, if an integer has been passed, a `NotSupportedError` MUST be
          thrown if the value is outside the range specified in
          [§ 2.5 Supported Render Quantum Sizes](#render-quantum-sizes), otherwise set the `[[render quantum size]]`
          private slot to the passed value.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R55">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Constructing an `OfflineAudioContext` with a `sampleRate` outside the supported range of 3000 Hz to 768000 Hz (inclusive) must throw a `NotSupportedError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>Implementations MUST support sample rates between 3000 Hz and 768000 Hz,
inclusive. A `NotSupportedError` MUST be thrown if a sample rate outside this
range is specified.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R56">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling the `OfflineAudioContext(numberOfChannels, length, sampleRate)` constructor with `numberOfChannels` equal to zero or outside the supported number of channels range must throw a `NotSupportedError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>A
    `NotSupportedError` exception MUST be thrown if any
    of the arguments is negative, zero, or outside its nominal
    range.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R57">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling the `OfflineAudioContext(numberOfChannels, length, sampleRate)` constructor with `length` equal to zero must throw a `NotSupportedError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>A
    `NotSupportedError` exception MUST be thrown if any
    of the arguments is negative, zero, or outside its nominal
    range.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R58">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling `startRendering()` on an `OfflineAudioContext` when its relevant global object's associated Document is not fully active must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError` `DOMException`.</description>
    <spec_quote>If this’s relevant global object’s associated Document is not fully active then return a promise rejected with "`InvalidStateError`" `DOMException`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R59">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling `startRendering()` on an `OfflineAudioContext` when `[[control thread state]]` is `"closed"` must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>If the `[[control thread state]]` on the
       `OfflineAudioContext` is `closed`, reject
       promise with `InvalidStateError` and abort these
       steps.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R60">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling `startRendering()` on an `OfflineAudioContext` whose `length` is not `null` when `[[committed frames]]` is greater than or equal to `length` must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>If the `OfflineAudioContext`’s
       `length` is not `null` and
       `[[committed frames]]` is greater than or equal to
       `OfflineAudioContext`’s `length`, reject
       promise with `InvalidStateError` and abort these
       steps.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R61">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>If creating the `AudioBuffer` during `startRendering()` throws an exception (for example, when `chunkSize` is 0 for an undefined-length context), `startRendering()` must return a promise rejected with that exception.</description>
    <spec_quote>If an exception was thrown during the preceding
       `AudioBuffer` constructor call, reject promise with
       this exception and return promise.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R62">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling `resume()` on an `OfflineAudioContext` when its relevant global object's associated Document is not fully active must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError` `DOMException`.</description>
    <spec_quote>If this’s relevant global object’s associated Document is
       not fully active then return a promise rejected with
       "`InvalidStateError`" `DOMException`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R63">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling `resume()` on an `OfflineAudioContext` when `[[control thread state]]` is `"closed"` must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>Abort these steps and reject promise with
       `InvalidStateError` when any of following conditions is true:

       * The `[[control thread state]]` on the `OfflineAudioContext`
         is `closed`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R64">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling `resume()` on an `OfflineAudioContext` when `[[rendering started]]` is `false` (before `startRendering()` has been called) must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>Abort these steps and reject promise with
       `InvalidStateError` when any of following conditions is true:

       * The `[[control thread state]]` on the `OfflineAudioContext`
         is `closed`.
       * The `[[rendering started]]` slot on the `OfflineAudioContext`
         is *false*.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
  <requirement id="R65">
    <category>Error Scenarios</category>
    <description>Calling `suspend(suspendTime)` on an `OfflineAudioContext` with a `suspendTime` whose quantized frame number is negative must return a promise rejected with an `InvalidStateError`.</description>
    <spec_quote>If the quantized frame number  1. is negative or 2. is less than or equal to the current time or 3. is greater than or equal to the total render duration or 4. is scheduled by another suspend for the same time,  then the promise is rejected with `InvalidStateError`.</spec_quote>
  </requirement>
